component.name: FlashCraft
component.summary: Write bootable images to removable drives

description.p: FlashCraft writes bootable images (ISO 9660, disk images) to removable drives, byte-for-byte, with read-back verification. A clean-room, pure-Rust reimplementation of Rufus — native, small, no Electron.
Only removable, unmounted devices can be written: the safety is structural, not a warning you can click through.
